name: Sunray Sierra 2-Person Indoor Infrared Sauna 200K
description: Description The SunRay Sierra 2-Person Indoor Infrared Sauna is constructed from Canadian red cedar for durability and a natural look. It uses 7 carbon nano heaters to produce smooth, evenly dispersed infrared heat up to 140°F without hot zones. Standard features include dual interior and exterior keypads, Bluetooth speakers, movable ergonomic backrests, chromatherapy lighting, an oxygen ionization system, recessed lighting, and tempered glass. Compact and efficient, the Sierra sauna combines functionality and comfort for home wellness.
